anon.title: Your sports profile
anon.message: Sign in to add your sports and level — it makes finding people to play with easier.

verified.label: Verified
verified.howText: For now we verify manually: a moderator checks the profile and games played. Adding a photo and your sports speeds it up.

empty.sports: Add your sports to show up in suggestions.
empty.availability: Not set — add the times that suit you in your profile.

hidden.title: You’re hidden from suggestions
hidden.text: Others won’t see you in the People tab. You can change this in Edit profile.

levelHints.1: Just starting, I know the rules
levelHints.2: I play now and then, for myself
levelHints.4: I play a lot, with solid technique and tactics

goalHints.fun: Play for fun and meet people

reliability.explain: Share of games you showed up for, as marked by organizers.
reliability.pendingExplain: Organizers mark who showed up. Be on time — others can see it.

home.title: Better suggestions nearby
home.explain: You can set your home area from your location. We store only an approximate area (~500 m); others see only your district and “~N km”.
home.unavailable: Couldn’t get your location. Allow location access or choose your district manually.
home.rateLimited: You can change your home area up to 5 times a day

avatar.hint: A photo helps you recognise each other at the venue

edit.name: Name
edit.bioPlaceholder: For example: I play in the evenings, looking for a weekend team
edit.sportsHint: Pick your sports and your level
edit.availabilityHint: Others only see the overlap with their own schedule
edit.districtHint: Others see only the district, never an address
edit.discoverableHint: If off, you won’t appear in the People tab. Events and chats work as usual.
